project.notice: Saved evidence only. Appearance is not engineering material certification. Numerical verification is not structural approval.

contextBounds: Existing evidence adapter: latest 100 engineering records, up to 30 returned analyses, 100 selected objects and 100 CAD references. This is not a complete project inventory or a method validation.

capabilities.read_context: Read saved project, selected objects, CAD sources and engineering evidence. Never executes analyses.
capabilities.list_projects: List up to 50 projects owned by the authenticated user.
capabilities.read_quantities: Read existing saved quantities and cost estimates; no recalculation.
capabilities.read_capabilities: Read authoritative supported-method and current/stale saved-result gates. Does not run analyses.
capabilities.read_diagnostics: Read existing runtime diagnostics with a bounded solver version-only probe; no numerical analysis or inference.
capabilities.navigate: Prepare a link to an existing website tool. Analysis, imports, exports and saving require manual review in that tool.
capabilities.prepare_position_preview: Prepare a visual position preview for one selected editable component, in East/North/Up metres. Does not apply or save. User must review Preview, Apply, then Save model in the existing editor.

limits: Only bounded read tools and position previews. Saving, CAD/file operations and numerical analyses require explicit existing application review and authorization. Never claim execution from navigation.
